scope: private source-owned fixed Tool publication; no execution grant

producer.make: <family>Publication2(declaration) -> exact synchronous original editor callback; rejects unbranded declaration
producer.lookup: get<Family>Publication2(callback) -> exact declaration or undefined, private WeakMap
producer.plugin: yield* ctx.tool.transform(<family>Publication2(declaration)) at original registration statement, preserve hooks/order and return same declaration
producer.bundles: original namespace if present then original add order; no callbacks during factory construction

consumer.begin: inventoryToolPublication(token,callback,scope) before register; requires same original activation Scope/location/source and one publication per declaration
consumer.replay: inventoryToolReplay(token) synchronous check before original callback; reject unknown/stale/disposed/finalizing, advance generation
consumer.result: returned declaration must equal published declaration for configured getter
